article.title: Hakeem Jeffries, Midterm Elections, and the Duopoly "Blue Wave"
article.author: bareditors
article.content: Hakeem Jeffries, Midterm Elections, and the Duopoly "Blue Wave" Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Fri, 11/20/2026 - 06:42 Anthony Rogers-Wright is an international climate and environmental liberation advocate, a Black Agenda Report contributor and a co-coordinator of the Black Alliance for Peace Climate, Environment and Militarism Working Group . He discusses the midterm election results and new Speaker of the House, Hakeem Jeffries, as democrats cooperate with republicans in defiance of their voters' demands for change. US Politics Hakeem Jeffries Congress House of Representatives Democrats Black Electoral Politics midterm elections
